notes: Higher stick wins. Bounder 500, hunter 750, shadow lord 1500. Footballs 250, 500, 750, then 1,000, plus 500 caught in the air.
Stay off the pit and flap free of the hand. Pterodactyl 1000, only in its open mouth. Extra life every 20,000.

victories: catch a football in the air.
hit the pterodactyl in its open mouth.
